mojo.abi_promise: none; Mojo has no stable ABI, so the guarantee is source compatibility only

numerical_contracts: pred_contrib rows sum to the raw score exactly
predict(num_iteration=k) equals a k-round fit; [0,k) plus [k,n) equals the whole raw score
save and load round trips bit-exactly
all-ones sample_weight equals no sample_weight, bit-identically
no callbacks means no boundary crossing and a bit-identical model
a sparse fit equals the dense fit with gaps filled with zeros
a repeat run on the same device is bit-identical
worker count does not change a CPU result
CPU and GPU agree within a Float32 tolerance with exact integer counts, and are not bit-identical to each other
